title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wow, you got so many! You really can do it when you try!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I'll take good care of them! Seeing as you went to all this trouble and—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, I mean, thanks or whatever. Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now, where should I put them? I'll need one by my bedside, obviously, and another on my desk…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, let's put one in your office too! Then we'll matc—I mean, it'll be like a souvenir!
